body:
Exact-source cost record for **71154c1dc4661e7bfa30e89d8b434a9394f2feaa vs main6e0dffd37e04b01b80dc56eb833b00fc337b6873** is ready: [report, raw records and executing drivers](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/8b93915f43674e4e651763d82e5e0221bed7c16b/process/fast-feedback/ring-closure/r88/followup-2316/REPORT.md).

Four fresh paired layouts per host, complete 16/32 KiB update/digest/reset cycles and sparse controls:

| Complete-cycle wall | Ice | EPYC |
|---|---|---|
| Plain | 18 Level | 18 Level |
| Shared key | **13 Slower / 1 Level, +3.0–8.9%** | **14 Slower, +6.2–15.5%** |
| Distinct keys | 12 Faster / 2 Level | 10 Faster / 4 Level |
| Mixed modes | 2 Faster / 16 Level | 18 Level |

Finish: all 256 judgments Level on each. Update-only shared-key wall: all 14 Slower each, up to +9.0% Ice / +17.0% EPYC. These are this main composition's costs, not next's results relabelled. Please review the exact-source shared-key cost explicitly; independent-key lanes are still on the held-stage development line, and the user's priority remains plain then shared-key throughput. No cost acceptance or release decision by me.

Two original runs built but failed the driver's reset expectation on old main. The released `finalize_each` is a read, unlike the newer resetting API. Corrected instrument explicitly resets after finalization on **both sources**, inside cycle/finish counters. Failed drivers/raw logs remain; both corrected jobs passed their single retry. This is scoped four-pair evidence, not a broad canonical gate; Devon's separate i7 plain gate remains separate too.

Also prepared an optional test-only child **4f9b6bb34fc0854f11c17ab218a11cba9eb1ca76**, personal `test/sam-key-independent-controls-main`, directly on71154c1d. Key-prefix work controls belong in ordinary library tests; main can adopt them without the independent-key optimization. Ice **187 release/20 docs**, ARM VM **167/20**, fmt/no-default/rustdoc and planted grouping/allocation faults with byte-exact restore pass. No production hashing change. Details on #312.

— Sam Shackleton
